episode.theme_zh: 一只好奇的狸花白猫在雨停前后发现十个小惊喜
episode.arc_zh: 从卧室里的雨声开始，独立的小探险逐渐走向放晴，最后带着一片小叶子回家休息

shots.beat_zh: 雨声把团团叫醒，它从柔软的被子里探头观察窗外。
action_timeline_zh: 25–75% 穿过被子缓慢走向窗边
shots.start_image_prompt_en: A wide horizontal cinematic view of the same kitten on a rumpled white bed in a softly lit bedroom. A rain-speckled window is on the right, the kitten sits near the lower center and looks toward the window. Realistic fur, soft gray morning light, no writing in the room.
shots.motion_prompt_en: A gentle low follow-camera glides beside the kitten as it wakes, walks two small steps across the bedding, and pauses at the rainy window. The cat remains visible throughout; one slow continuous camera movement, subtle head and ear motion.
shots.ambience_prompt_en: Quiet rainfall on glass, soft bedding rustle, tiny paw steps, distant indoor room tone.
must_preserve_en: the same white bed and right-side rainy window
the kitten's white facial blaze and striped tail

shots.beat_zh: 团团贴近镜头，第一次发现窗上的雨滴会跟着爪尖滑动。
action_timeline_zh: 25–75% 抬起一只前爪轻碰玻璃
shots.start_image_prompt_en: Close, intimate horizontal vlog framing of the same kitten beside a rain-streaked window. The face occupies the left third, a single clear droplet is visible on the glass to the right. Keep its pink nose, round eyes, white blaze and realistic whiskers recognizable.
shots.motion_prompt_en: A close handheld vlog shot with very small natural sway. The kitten looks into the lens, reaches one normal paw toward a raindrop, then tracks the drop sliding down the pane and tilts its head. No jump cuts within this shot.
shots.ambience_prompt_en: Soft rain ticking on the window, one faint paw tap on glass, a gentle curious kitten chirp, indoor hush.
must_preserve_en: one rain-streaked window on the right
the exact kitten face markings and pink nose

shots.beat_zh: 镜头像团团的眼睛一样贴地穿过走廊，寻找响了一声的小玩具。
action_timeline_zh: 0–25% 低视角发现走廊尽头的小球
75–100% 一只白爪伸入画面碰到小球
shots.start_image_prompt_en: A first-person cat-eye-height view down a warm apartment hallway, a tiny felt ball near the far skirting board. Only a subtle tip of the same kitten's ears may appear at the bottom edge; realistic low perspective, no person in the hall.
shots.motion_prompt_en: One continuous low point-of-view move along the floor toward a small felt ball. The camera advances a short, plausible distance, pauses, and a single white feline paw gently taps the ball. Mild natural head-bob, no flying camera or sudden teleport.
shots.ambience_prompt_en: Quiet hallway air, soft pads on wood, one gentle bell-like rattle from the felt toy.
must_preserve_en: the same hallway vanishing point and small felt ball
a normal white feline paw if visible

shots.beat_zh: 团团从小篮子里选出一条红丝带，像认真准备出门的小导演。
action_timeline_zh: 25–75% 用嘴轻轻叼出一条红丝带
shots.start_image_prompt_en: Wide horizontal living room floor view. The same kitten stands beside a low woven toy basket on a soft rug; one loose red ribbon lies at the basket edge. Daylight is diffused by clouds. Cat proportions and original white paws remain natural.
shots.motion_prompt_en: A calm floor-level follow shot. The kitten sniffs the basket, gently takes the ribbon tip in its mouth, steps back once and looks at the lens. It remains four-legged; the action is lightly playful, never human mime.
shots.ambience_prompt_en: Soft rug footsteps, wicker rustle, a faint ribbon swish, quiet room tone.
must_preserve_en: one low wicker basket and one red ribbon
four normal feline paws and fixed coat markings

shots.beat_zh: 雨渐小，团团在门口对着镜头犹豫片刻，决定迈出去。
shots.start_image_prompt_en: Close horizontal vlog composition of the same kitten at the inside of a half-open home doorway. Damp pavement and soft daylight are visible beyond the threshold. The kitten fills the center-left and looks into the lens; no human is present.
shots.motion_prompt_en: A nearly stationary intimate camera with slight natural handheld sway. The kitten looks at the lens, sniffs the air through the open door, pauses, and confidently takes one careful step toward the damp threshold.
shots.ambience_prompt_en: Rain fading outside, distant birds beginning to sing, soft paw touch on the doorway wood.
must_preserve_en: the half-open doorway and damp outside
same kitten scale and facial markings
must_avoid_en: human opening the door on screen

shots.beat_zh: 团团发现一小片倒映天空的积水，试着轻轻跳过。
action_timeline_zh: 25–75% 轻轻跃过不足一步宽的水面
shots.start_image_prompt_en: A quiet pedestrian alley after rain, horizontal wide shot from kitten height. The same kitten stands side-on beside a small shallow puddle reflecting pale clouds; no traffic. Keep recognizable tabby saddle, white legs, and ringed tail.
shots.motion_prompt_en: A low side-follow camera tracks one brief, physically plausible hop across a narrow puddle, then slows as the kitten looks back. Show natural four-paw takeoff and landing, a tiny splash, no slow-motion flying.
shots.ambience_prompt_en: Soft alley breeze, four paws pattering on damp stone, one small water splash, distant city hush.
must_preserve_en: one narrow shallow puddle
same cat coat pattern and striped tail

shots.beat_zh: 猫眼视角钻进雨后的草丛，发现叶尖上一颗闪亮水珠。
action_timeline_zh: 75–100% 白爪轻碰叶片，水珠微颤
shots.start_image_prompt_en: A realistic cat-eye-height point of view inside a modest city park after rain. Wet leaves frame the edges, a single clear bead of water rests on one leaf tip in the midground. A subtle edge of striped ear may be visible low in frame, no full cat body.
shots.motion_prompt_en: One careful low point-of-view glide between wet leaves, stopping close to a water bead. A single white cat paw brushes the stem gently; the droplet trembles in place. Shallow natural parallax, no high drone flight.
shots.ambience_prompt_en: Quiet leaves moving after rain, one close water drip, faint birdsong and a delicate leaf rustle.
must_preserve_en: one identifiable leaf-tip droplet
cat-eye camera height

shots.beat_zh: 阳光出来了，团团在小花园里追逐一只蝴蝶，但最后只是安静地看它飞走。
shots.start_image_prompt_en: Wide horizontal garden shot after rainfall. The same kitten stands among short flowers and wet stepping stones; one small pale butterfly hovers just ahead. Warm late-afternoon sun breaks through, cat remains large enough to recognize its face and coat.
shots.motion_prompt_en: A gentle follow shot moves with the kitten for two playful short steps toward a butterfly, then stops as the cat lets it fly away and looks upward. Natural feline gait, warm sun glints on still-wet leaves.
shots.ambience_prompt_en: Light garden breeze, soft paws on stone, leaves brushing, gentle birds nearby; no voice or song.
must_preserve_en: one pale butterfly and wet stepping stones
same kitten face and tail markings

shots.beat_zh: 团团在安静咖啡馆窗外像小主播一样面对镜头，发现玻璃里还有自己的倒影。
action_timeline_zh: 75–100% 再转回镜头轻轻喵一声
shots.start_image_prompt_en: Close horizontal vlog framing of the same kitten sitting safely outside a quiet cafe window at dusk. The kitten's face is prominent, warm interior lights reflect faintly on glass to the right; no readable signs or people.
shots.motion_prompt_en: A close handheld vlog shot with minimal sway. The kitten blinks into the lens, notices its own faint reflection, turns its head to the right, then looks back and gives a small natural meow. No spoken words.
shots.ambience_prompt_en: Muted outdoor evening air, soft window-side city murmur, one quiet natural cat meow, faint glass-side paw shuffle.
must_preserve_en: one real cat and its faint reflection
warm cafe window on the right

shots.beat_zh: 小冒险结束，团团叼着一片落叶回到卧室，在床边蜷起来休息。
action_timeline_zh: 0–25% 团团从画面边缘走到床边
25–75% 放下一片小叶子并坐下
75–100% 在暖光下蜷起身慢慢闭眼
shots.start_image_prompt_en: Wide horizontal view of the same cozy bedroom at night, now lit by a soft warm bedside lamp. The same kitten enters near a low bed carrying one small fallen leaf lightly in its mouth. Keep the kitten fully visible and anatomically natural.
shots.motion_prompt_en: One gentle low follow camera accompanies the kitten a short distance to the bed. It puts down one little leaf, sits, curls up naturally and slowly closes its eyes. The camera eases to a stop; no fade to a different room.
shots.ambience_prompt_en: Quiet night room tone, tiny paw steps, a soft leaf rustle, one calm kitten breath and distant rain nearly gone.
must_preserve_en: one small fallen leaf and one low bed
the same cat coat pattern and normal curled body

protagonist.identity_prompt_en: The exact same small brown-gray tabby and white kitten from the approved reference photos: broad white blaze between the eyes, white muzzle, chest, belly and all four paws, soft brown tabby saddle and crown, round warm hazel-green eyes, pink nose, and a fluffy dark ringed tail. Normal four-legged feline anatomy and stable coat markings.
must_not_change_en: the white blaze and tabby face markings
the white chest and four white paws
the fluffy dark ringed tail and round eyes
the kitten's size and natural feline anatomy
